name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.add.eq_1
type:
∀ (c e : RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode),
  c.add e =
    ((c.positive * e.denominator + e.positive * c.denominator, c.negative * e.denominator + e.negative * c.denominator),
      c.denominator * e.denominator - 1)

type: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode → ℕ

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.denominator.eq_1
type: ∀ (c : RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode), c.denominator = c.2 + 1

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.denominator_pos

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.divisor.eq_1
type: ∀ (c : RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode), c.divisor = c.denominator.gcd c.magnitude

type: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode → RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode → Bool

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.equal.eq_1
type:
∀ (c e : RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode),
  c.equal e =
    decide
      (c.positive * e.denominator + e.negative * c.denominator =
        e.positive * c.denominator + c.negative * e.denominator)

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.equal_iff
type: ∀ (c e : RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode), c.equal e = true ↔ c.value = e.value

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.magnitude
type: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode → ℕ

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.magnitude.eq_1
type: ∀ (c : RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode), c.magnitude = c.positive - c.negative + (c.negative - c.positive)

type: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode → RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.neg.eq_1
type: ∀ (c : RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode), c.neg = ((c.negative, c.positive), c.2)

type: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode → ℕ

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.negative.eq_1
type: ∀ (c : RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode), c.negative = c.1.2

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.normalDenominator.eq_1
type: ∀ (c : RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode), c.normalDenominator = c.denominator / c.divisor

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.normalNegative
type: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode → ℕ

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.normalNegative.eq_1
type: ∀ (c : RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode), c.normalNegative = (c.negative - c.positive) / c.divisor

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.normalPositive
type: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode → ℕ

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.normalPositive.eq_1
type: ∀ (c : RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode), c.normalPositive = (c.positive - c.negative) / c.divisor

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.normal_fields
type:
∀ (c : RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode),
  c.value.num = ↑c.normalPositive - ↑c.normalNegative ∧ c.value.den = c.normalDenominator

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.numeratorResidue.eq_1
type:
∀ (c : RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode) (p : ℕ),
  c.numeratorResidue p = (c.normalPositive % p + p - c.normalNegative % p) % p

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.numeratorResidue_cast

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.positive
type: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode → ℕ

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.positive.eq_1
type: ∀ (c : RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode), c.positive = c.1.1

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.primeResidue
type: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode → ℕ → ℕ

name: RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode.primeResidue.eq_1
type:
∀ (c : RealizationBoundaries.RationalCode) (p : ℕ),
  c.primeResidue p = if c.normalDenominator % p = 0 then 0 else c.numeratorResidue p * c.normalDenominator ^ (p - 2) % p

∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x y : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient)
  ⦃K L : FiniteIndexNormalAddSubgroup ↑(AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W))⦄ (f : K ⟶ L),
  (ProfiniteAddGrp.Hom.hom
        ((ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.diagram (AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W))).map f))
      ((RealizationBoundaries.finiteTargetExtension W (↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) ⧸ K.toAddSubgroup)
          (RealizationBoundaries.quotientProjection W K))
        (x + y)) =
    (RealizationBoundaries.finiteTargetExtension W (↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) ⧸ L.toAddSubgroup)
        (RealizationBoundaries.quotientProjection W L))
      (x + y)

name: RealizationBoundaries.ambientToCompletion._proof_7
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x y : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  ⟨fun K =>
      (RealizationBoundaries.finiteTargetExtension W (↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) ⧸ K.toAddSubgroup)
          (RealizationBoundaries.quotientProjection W K))
        (x + y),
      ⋯⟩ =
    ⟨fun K =>
        (RealizationBoundaries.finiteTargetExtension W (↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) ⧸ K.toAddSubgroup)
            (RealizationBoundaries.quotientProjection W K))
          x,
        ⋯⟩ +
      ⟨fun K =>
        (RealizationBoundaries.finiteTargetExtension W (↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) ⧸ K.toAddSubgroup)
            (RealizationBoundaries.quotientProjection W K))
          y,

type:
∀ (i : RealizationBoundaries.BoundaryGroupCategory),
  ProfiniteAddGrp.ofHom
      (RealizationBoundaries.completionHom (RealizationBoundaries.boundarySubspace i)
        (RealizationBoundaries.boundarySubspace i) (AddGrpCat.Hom.hom (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id i).hom)) =

type: (RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) → ℚ → List ℕ → ℕ → Except ℕ (ℚ × List ℕ)

name: RealizationBoundaries.certifiedRootSolver.eq_1
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.certifiedRootSolver a r d m =
    match RealizationBoundaries.firstRootObstruction a r d m with
    | some p => Except.error p
    | none => Except.ok (r / ↑m, RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionCode a r d m)

name: RealizationBoundaries.certifiedRootSolver.match_1
type: (motive : Option ℕ → Sort u_1) → (x : Option ℕ) → ((p : ℕ) → motive (some p)) → (Unit → motive none) → motive x

name: RealizationBoundaries.certifiedRootSolver_error
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m n : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.certifiedRootSolver a r d m = Except.error n →
    ∃ (hp : Nat.Prime n), n ∣ m ∧ RealizationBoundaries.codedNormalValue a r d ⟨n, hp⟩ ≠ 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.certifiedRootSolver_ok
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (t : ℚ) (e : List ℕ),
      RealizationBoundaries.certifiedRootSolver a r d m = Except.ok (t, e) →
        m • RealizationBoundaries.codedNormalValue a t e = RealizationBoundaries.codedNormalValue a r d

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle.eq_1
type:

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_coordinate_nonzero_iff
type:

  ↑(RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S (1 / ↑↑p) (↑(↑p - 1) / ↑↑p)) p ≠ 0 ↔ p ∈ S

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_identity
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t v : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r t + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S (r + t) v =
    RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S t v + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r (t + v)

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_identity._abel_1_2
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t v : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S t -
        RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + t) +
      (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + t) + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S v -
        RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + (t + v))) =
    RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S t + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S v -
        RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (t + v) +
      (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (t + v) -
        RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + (t + v)))

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_neg
type: ∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ), RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r (-r) = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_not_removable
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime},
  S.Infinite → ¬∃ b, ∀ (r t : ℚ), RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r t + b r + b t - b (r + t) = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_not_removable._abel_1_2
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} (b : ℚ → ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport) (r t : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + ↑(b r) + (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S t + ↑(b t)) -
      (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + t) + ↑(b (r + t))) =
    RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S t -
            RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + t) +
          ↑(b r) +
        ↑(b t) -
      ↑(b (r + t))

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_reads_coordinate
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S (1 / ↑↑p) (↑(↑p - 1) / ↑↑p) =
    -⟨RealizationBoundaries.cut {p} (RealizationBoundaries.indicator S), ⋯⟩

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_symmetric
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r t = RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S t r

name: RealizationBoundaries.countedCertifiedRootSolver
type: (RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) → ℚ → List ℕ → ℕ → (Except ℕ (ℚ × List ℕ) × List RealizationBoundaries.Prime) × ℕ

name: RealizationBoundaries.countedCertifiedRootSolver.eq_1
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.countedCertifiedRootSolver a r d m =
    match
      (RealizationBoundaries.countedFindRootTrace (RealizationBoundaries.tracedRootObstructs a r d m)
            (List.range (m + 1))).1.1 with
    | some p =>
      ((Except.error p,
          (RealizationBoundaries.countedFindRootTrace (RealizationBoundaries.tracedRootObstructs a r d m)
                (List.range (m + 1))).1.2),
        (RealizationBoundaries.countedFindRootTrace (RealizationBoundaries.tracedRootObstructs a r d m)
            (List.range (m + 1))).2)
    | none =>
      have correction := RealizationBoundaries.tracedRootCorrectionCode a r d m;
      ((Except.ok (r / ↑m, correction.1),
          (RealizationBoundaries.countedFindRootTrace (RealizationBoundaries.tracedRootObstructs a r d m)
                  (List.range (m + 1))).1.2 ++
            correction.2),
        (RealizationBoundaries.countedFindRootTrace (RealizationBoundaries.tracedRootObstructs a r d m)
              (List.range (m + 1))).2 +
          RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionBound r d m)

∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m : ℕ),
  (RealizationBoundaries.countedCertifiedRootSolver a r d m).1 = RealizationBoundaries.tracedCertifiedRootSolver a r d m

      RealizationBoundaries.HasLeastPresentationDegree ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) ↑d ∧

                ∀ (b : ℕ → Bool),
                  RealizationBoundaries.CommonCofinalObservation
                    (RealizationBoundaries.allFiniteObservation

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootSolver
type: (RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) → ℚ → List ℕ → ℕ → Option (ℚ × List ℕ)

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootSolver.eq_1
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootSolver a r d m =
    if 0 < m ∧ RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootTest a r d m = true then
      some (r / ↑m, RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionCode a r d m)
    else none

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootSolver_complete
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ((∃ t e, RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootSolver a r d m = some (t, e)) ↔
      ∃ y, m • y = ⟨RealizationBoundaries.codedNormalValue a r d, ⋯⟩)

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootSolver_rejection_certificate
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootSolver a r d m = none →
      ∃ p, ↑p ∣ m ∧ RealizationBoundaries.codedNormalValue a r d p ≠ 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootSolver_some_iff
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m : ℕ) (t : ℚ) (e : List ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootSolver a r d m = some (t, e) ↔
    0 < m ∧
      RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootTest a r d m = true ∧
        t = r / ↑m ∧ e = RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionCode a r d m

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootSolver_sound
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m : ℕ) (t : ℚ) (e : List ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootSolver a r d m = some (t, e) →
    m • RealizationBoundaries.codedNormalValue a t e = RealizationBoundaries.codedNormalValue a r d

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootSolver_support_bound
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
      RealizationBoundaries.finiteCodeValue d p = 0 →
        ¬↑p ∣ r.den * (r / ↑m).den →
          RealizationBoundaries.finiteCodeValue (RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionCode a r d m) p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootTest

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootTest.eq_1
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootTest a r d m =
    (List.range (m + 1)).all fun n =>
      if h : Nat.Prime n then if n ∣ m then decide (RealizationBoundaries.codedNormalValue a r d ⟨n, h⟩ = 0) else true
      else true

  0 < m →

      ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m → RealizationBoundaries.codedNormalValue a r d p = 0)

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteRootTest_exact._simp_1_3

name: RealizationBoundaries.localCocycleQuerySchedule_mem._simp_1_3
type: ∀ {m n : ℕ}, (m ∈ List.range n) = (m < n)

name: RealizationBoundaries.localCocycleQuerySchedule_nodup
type: ∀ (input N : ℕ), (RealizationBoundaries.localCocycleQuerySchedule input N).Nodup

name: RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAddCell
type: (ℕ → Bool) → ℕ → ℕ

name: RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAddCell_eq
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (z : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAddCell a z =
    if RealizationBoundaries.localCocycleException z then RealizationBoundaries.normalAddCell a z
    else RealizationBoundaries.normalAddBaseCell z

name: RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAddCell_oracleComputable
type:
∀ (a X : ℕ → Bool),
  RealizationBoundaries.SelectorReducible a X →
    RealizationBoundaries.OracleComputable X (RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAddCell a)

name: RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAddCell_same_prime_residue
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (c e : RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  ↑(RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAddCell a (Nat.pair (Nat.pair (Encodable.encode c) (Encodable.encode e)) ↑p)) =
    ↑(RealizationBoundaries.normalAddCell a (Nat.pair (Nat.pair (Encodable.encode c) (Encodable.encode e)) ↑p))

name: RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAddCell_same_prime_residue._simp_1_3
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {i : ℕ} {a : α}, l[i]?.getD a = l.getD i a

name: RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAddResidues
type: (ℕ → Bool) → RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode → RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode → List ℕ

name: RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAddResidues.eq_1
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (c e : RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode),
  RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAddResidues a c e =
    RealizationBoundaries.residueLoop (RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAddCell a)
      (Nat.pair (Encodable.encode c) (Encodable.encode e)) (RealizationBoundaries.normalAddBound c e)

name: RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAddResidues_same
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (c e : RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteCodeValue (RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAddResidues a c e) =
    RealizationBoundaries.finiteCodeValue (RealizationBoundaries.normalAddResidues a c e)

name: RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAdd_correct
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (c e : RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode),
  RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalValue a (c.1.add e.1, RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAddResidues a c e) =
    RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalValue a c + RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalValue a e

name: RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAdd_loop_oracleComputable
type:
∀ (a X : ℕ → Bool),
  RealizationBoundaries.SelectorReducible a X →
    RealizationBoundaries.OracleComputable X fun z =>
      Encodable.encode
        (RealizationBoundaries.residueLoop (RealizationBoundaries.localNormalAddCell a) (Nat.unpair z).1
          (Nat.unpair z).2)

name: RealizationBoundaries.markedElement
type: (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) → ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S)

name: RealizationBoundaries.markedElement._proof_1
type: ∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime), RealizationBoundaries.indicator S ∈ RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S

name: RealizationBoundaries.markedElement_not_finiteSupport
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime},
  S.Infinite → ↑(RealizationBoundaries.markedElement S) ∉ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.marked_even_root_iff
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.HasPrimeRoot (RealizationBoundaries.markedElement (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a))
      (RealizationBoundaries.primeAt (2 * n)) ↔
    a n = true

name: RealizationBoundaries.marked_odd_root_iff
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.HasPrimeRoot (RealizationBoundaries.markedElement (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a))
      (RealizationBoundaries.primeAt (2 * n + 1)) ↔
    a n = false

name: RealizationBoundaries.marked_prime_root_iff
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  (∃ y, ↑p • y = RealizationBoundaries.markedElement S) ↔ p ∉ S

name: RealizationBoundaries.marked_root_presentation_reduces
type:
∀ (a X : ℕ → Bool) {H : Type u_1} [inst : AddGroup H] (c : RealizationBoundaries.RootSearchPresentation X H)
  (e : H ≃+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)),
  e c.target = RealizationBoundaries.markedElement (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a) →
    c.offset = 0 → RealizationBoundaries.SelectorReducible a X

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_coordinateKernel
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ↥H),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.coordinateKernel H p ↔ ↑x p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_coordinateKernel._simp_1
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ↥H),
  (x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.coordinateKernel H p) = (↑x p = 0)

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_finiteSupport
type:
∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ↔ (RealizationBoundaries.support x).Finite

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_finiteSupport._simp_1
type:
∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  (x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport) = (RealizationBoundaries.support x).Finite

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_multiples
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m ↔ ∃ y, m • y = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_multiples._simp_1
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m) = ∃ y, m • y = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_preimage
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.preimage W ↔ RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x ∈ W

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_preimage._simp_1
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  (x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) = (RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x ∈ W)

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_quotient_image_iff
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H →
    ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
      RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H ↔ x ∈ H

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_rationalImage
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (hD : RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H)
  (hH : RealizationBoundaries.IsPure H) (v : RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace),
  v ∈ RealizationBoundaries.rationalImage H hD hH ↔ v ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_rationalImage._simp_1
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (hD : RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H)
  (hH : RealizationBoundaries.IsPure H) (v : RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace),
  (v ∈ RealizationBoundaries.rationalImage H hD hH) = (v ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H)

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_rootKernel
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  y ∈ RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m ↔ m • y = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_rootKernel._simp_1
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (y ∈ RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m) = (m • y = 0)

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_selectorGroup_iff
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S ↔
    ∃ r, r • RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap (RealizationBoundaries.indicator S) = RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_spectrumSubgroup
type:
∀ (B : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup B ↔ RealizationBoundaries.support ↑x ⊆ B

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_spectrumSubgroup._simp_1
type:
∀ (B : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  (x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup B) = (RealizationBoundaries.support ↑x ⊆ B)

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_support
type: ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), p ∈ RealizationBoundaries.support x ↔ x p ≠ 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_support._simp_1
type:
∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  (p ∈ RealizationBoundaries.support x) = (x p ≠ 0)

name: RealizationBoundaries.multiples
type: (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) → ℕ → AddSubgroup ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)

name: RealizationBoundaries.multiples_antitone
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m n : ℕ},
  m ∣ n → RealizationBoundaries.multiples W n ≤ RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m

name: RealizationBoundaries.multiples_eq_of_same_prime_divisors
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m n : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    0 < n →
      (∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m ↔ ↑p ∣ n) →
        RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m = RealizationBoundaries.multiples W n

name: RealizationBoundaries.multiples_eq_radical
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m = RealizationBoundaries.multiples W (RealizationBoundaries.primeRadical m)

name: RealizationBoundaries.multiples_open
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → IsOpen ↑(RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m)

name: RealizationBoundaries.natSubgroupCantorHomeomorph
type: (ℕ → Bool) ≃ₜ AddSubgroup ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalAdd
type:
(ℕ → Bool) →
  RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode →
    RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode → RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode

name: RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalAdd_exact
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (c e : RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode),
  RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalValue a (RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalAdd a c e) =
    RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalValue a c + RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalValue a e

name: RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalAdd_exact._abel_1_1
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (c e : RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a) (c.1.value + e.1.value) +
      (RealizationBoundaries.finiteCodeValue c.2 + RealizationBoundaries.finiteCodeValue e.2 +
        (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a) c.1.value +
            RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a) e.1.value -
          RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a) (c.1.value + e.1.value))) =
    RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a) c.1.value +
        RealizationBoundaries.finiteCodeValue c.2 +
      (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a) e.1.value +
        RealizationBoundaries.finiteCodeValue e.2)

name: RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalEqual
type: RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode → RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode → Bool

name: RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalEqual.eq_1
type:
∀ (c e : RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode),
  RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalEqual c e = (c.1.equal e.1 && decide (RealizationBoundaries.ResiduesEqual c.2 e.2))

name: RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalEqual_exact
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (c e : RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode),
  RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalEqual c e = true ↔
    RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalValue a c = RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalValue a e

name: RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalValue
type: (a : ℕ → Bool) → RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode → ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)

name: RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalValue._proof_1
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (c : RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a) c.1.value +
      RealizationBoundaries.finiteCodeValue c.2 ∈
    RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a

name: RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalValue_surjective
type: ∀ (a : ℕ → Bool), Function.Surjective (RealizationBoundaries.nativeNormalValue a)

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_completion_invariant_reconstruction
type:
∀ (R : (ℕ → Bool) → Type u_1) [inst : (a : ℕ → Bool) → AddGroup (R a)],
  (∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
      Nonempty
          (↑(RealizationBoundaries.CanonicalCompletion
                    (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a))).toProfinite.toTop ≃ₜ+
            ↑(RealizationBoundaries.CanonicalCompletion
                    (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector b))).toProfinite.toTop) →
        Nonempty (R a ≃+ R b)) →
    (∀ (a : ℕ → Bool), Nonempty (R a ≃+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a))) → False

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_injective_hom_of_infinite_disagreement
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    ∀ (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)), ¬Function.Injective ⇑f

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_lift_of_commonCompletionEquiv
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    ¬∃ f,
        ∀ (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)),
          (RealizationBoundaries.pairedCommonCompletionEquiv a b)
              (ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)) x) =
            ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)) (f x)

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_section
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (w : ↥W),
  w ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (s : ↥W →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
      (RealizationBoundaries.preimageProjection W).comp s ≠ AddMonoidHom.id ↥W

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_section_of_nontrivial
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) [Nontrivial ↥W],
  ¬∃ s, (RealizationBoundaries.preimageProjection W).comp s = AddMonoidHom.id ↥W

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_surjective_hom_of_infinite_disagreement
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    ∀ (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)), ¬Function.Surjective ⇑f

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_unmarked_observation_decoder
type:
∀ (R : RealizationBoundaries.ObservationDecoder),
  (∀ (a : ℕ → Bool),
      Nonempty
        (R.decode
            (RealizationBoundaries.allFiniteObservation
              (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a))) ≅
          AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a))) →
    False

name: RealizationBoundaries.nontorsion_source_of_image
type:
∀ (U V : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage U) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage V))
  (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage U)),
  ↑(f x) ∉ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport → ↑x ∉ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.nonzero_coordinate
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)), x ≠ 0 → ∃ p, ↑x p ≠ 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd
type:
Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime →
  ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport →
    ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport → ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd.eq_1
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y = (x.1 + y.1, x.2 + y.2 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S x.1 y.1)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAddBaseCell
type: ℕ → ℕ

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAddBaseCell.eq_1
type:
∀ (z : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAddBaseCell z =
    ((RealizationBoundaries.decodeNormalCode (Nat.unpair (Nat.unpair z).1).1).2.getD (Nat.unpair z).2 0 +
        (RealizationBoundaries.decodeNormalCode (Nat.unpair (Nat.unpair z).1).2).2.getD (Nat.unpair z).2 0) %
      (Nat.unpair z).2

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAddBound
type: RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode → RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode → ℕ

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAddCell
type: (ℕ → Bool) → ℕ → ℕ

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAddCell.eq_1
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (z : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAddCell a z =
    ((RealizationBoundaries.decodeNormalCode (Nat.unpair (Nat.unpair z).1).1).2.getD (Nat.unpair z).2 0 +
          (RealizationBoundaries.decodeNormalCode (Nat.unpair (Nat.unpair z).1).2).2.getD (Nat.unpair z).2 0 +
        RealizationBoundaries.pairedMask a (Nat.unpair z).2 *
          ((RealizationBoundaries.decodeNormalCode (Nat.unpair (Nat.unpair z).1).1).1.primeResidue (Nat.unpair z).2 +
                (RealizationBoundaries.decodeNormalCode (Nat.unpair (Nat.unpair z).1).2).1.primeResidue
                  (Nat.unpair z).2 +
              (Nat.unpair z).2 -
            ((RealizationBoundaries.decodeNormalCode (Nat.unpair (Nat.unpair z).1).1).1.add
                  (RealizationBoundaries.decodeNormalCode (Nat.unpair (Nat.unpair z).1).2).1).primeResidue
              (Nat.unpair z).2)) %
      (Nat.unpair z).2

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAddCellUsingBit
type: Bool → ℕ → ℕ

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAddCell_cast
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (c e : RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  ↑(RealizationBoundaries.normalAddCell a (Nat.pair (Nat.pair (Encodable.encode c) (Encodable.encode e)) ↑p)) =
    RealizationBoundaries.finiteCodeValue c.2 p + RealizationBoundaries.finiteCodeValue e.2 p +
      RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a) c.1.value e.1.value p

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAddCell_cast._simp_1_2
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {i : ℕ} {a : α}, l[i]?.getD a = l.getD i a

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAddCell_oracleComputable
type:
∀ (a X : ℕ → Bool),
  RealizationBoundaries.SelectorReducible a X →
    RealizationBoundaries.OracleComputable X (RealizationBoundaries.normalAddCell a)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAddResidues
type: (ℕ → Bool) → RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode → RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode → List ℕ

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAddResidues.eq_1
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (c e : RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAddResidues a c e =
    RealizationBoundaries.residueLoop (RealizationBoundaries.normalAddCell a)
      (Nat.pair (Encodable.encode c) (Encodable.encode e)) (RealizationBoundaries.normalAddBound c e)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAddResidues_exact
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (c e : RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteCodeValue (RealizationBoundaries.normalAddResidues a c e) =
    RealizationBoundaries.finiteCodeValue c.2 + RealizationBoundaries.finiteCodeValue e.2 +
      RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a) c.1.value e.1.value

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAddResidues_exact._proof_1_2
type:
∀ (c e : RealizationBoundaries.NativeNormalCode) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  ↑p ≤ c.1.value.den * e.1.value.den → c.1.value.den * e.1.value.den + 1 ≤ ↑p → False

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_assoc
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y z : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S (RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y) z =
    RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x (RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S y z)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_assoc._abel_1_1
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y z : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  x.2 + y.2 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S x.1 y.1 + z.2 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S (x.1 + y.1) z.1 =
    x.2 + y.2 + z.2 + (RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S x.1 y.1 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S (x.1 + y.1) z.1)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_assoc._abel_1_2
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y z : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  x.2 + y.2 + z.2 + (RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S y.1 z.1 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S x.1 (y.1 + z.1)) =
    x.2 + (y.2 + z.2 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S y.1 z.1) + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S x.1 (y.1 + z.1)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_comm
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y = RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S y x

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_inverse
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x (-x.1, -x.2) = (0, 0)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_zero
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x (0, 0) = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate
type:
(S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) →
  ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport → ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate._proof_1
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S x.1 + ↑x.2 ∈ RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate_add
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S (RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y) =
    RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S x + RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S y

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate_add._abel_1_2
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (x.1 + y.1) +
      (↑x.2 + ↑y.2 +
        (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S x.1 + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S y.1 -
          RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (x.1 + y.1))) =
    RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S x.1 + ↑x.2 + (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S y.1 + ↑y.2)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate_bijective
type: ∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime}, S.Infinite → Function.Bijective (RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalFormEquiv
type:
{S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} →
  S.Infinite → ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≃ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransport

∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite)

        RealizationBoundaries.coordinateDivide m ↑x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.preimage W

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalizedRoot._proof_2

  (h : ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m → ↑x p = 0), m • ⟨RealizationBoundaries.coordinateDivide m ↑x, ⋯⟩ = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalizedRoot.congr_simp
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W))
  (h : ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m → ↑x p = 0),

∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W))
  (h : ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m → ↑x p = 0) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  ↑↑(RealizationBoundaries.normalizedRoot W hm x h) p = (↑m)⁻¹ * ↑x p

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalizedRoot_exceptional_zero
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W))
  (h : ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m → ↑x p = 0) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  ↑p ∣ m → ↑↑(RealizationBoundaries.normalizedRoot W hm x h) p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalizedRoot_unique
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W))
  (h : ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m → ↑x p = 0) (y : RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x),

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientScalar._proof_5

type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime),

type:
∀ (B : ℕ → ℕ → Bool) (C : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.repeatedDiagonal B C n =
    if n % 2 = 0 then !B (Nat.unpair (n / 2)).1 n else C (Nat.unpair (n / 2)).1

name: RealizationBoundaries.repeatedDiagonal_even
type:
∀ (B : ℕ → ℕ → Bool) (C : ℕ → Bool) (j k : ℕ),

name: RealizationBoundaries.repeatedDiagonal_free_infinite_disagreement
type:
∀ (B : ℕ → ℕ → Bool) (C D : ℕ → Bool),
  C ≠ D → {n | RealizationBoundaries.repeatedDiagonal B C n ≠ RealizationBoundaries.repeatedDiagonal B D n}.Infinite

name: RealizationBoundaries.repeatedDiagonal_free_infinite_disagreement._proof_1_1
type: ∀ (j : ℕ) ⦃k l : ℕ⦄, 2 * Nat.pair j k + 1 = 2 * Nat.pair j l + 1 → ¬Nat.pair j k = Nat.pair j l → False

name: RealizationBoundaries.repeatedDiagonal_infinite_disagreement
type: ∀ (B : ℕ → ℕ → Bool) (C : ℕ → Bool) (j : ℕ), {n | RealizationBoundaries.repeatedDiagonal B C n ≠ B j n}.Infinite

name: RealizationBoundaries.repeatedDiagonal_infinite_disagreement._proof_1_1
type: ∀ (j : ℕ) ⦃k l : ℕ⦄, 2 * Nat.pair j k = 2 * Nat.pair j l → ¬Nat.pair j k = Nat.pair j l → False

name: RealizationBoundaries.repeatedDiagonal_odd
type: ∀ (B : ℕ → ℕ → Bool) (C : ℕ → Bool) (j k : ℕ), RealizationBoundaries.repeatedDiagonal B C (2 * Nat.pair j k + 1) = C j

name: RealizationBoundaries.repeatedDiagonal_odd._proof_1_1
type: ∀ (j k : ℕ), ¬(2 * Nat.pair j k + 1) / 2 = Nat.pair j k → False

name: RealizationBoundaries.repeatedDiagonal_odd._proof_1_2
type: ∀ (j k : ℕ), (2 * Nat.pair j k + 1) / 2 = Nat.pair j k → ¬(2 * Nat.pair j k + 1) % 2 = 1 → False

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionBound

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionCode

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionCode.eq_1
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionCode a r d m =
    List.ofFn fun i =>
      if h : Nat.Prime ↑i then ZMod.val (RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionValue a r d m ⟨↑i, h⟩) else 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionCode_exact
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    RealizationBoundaries.finiteCodeValue (RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionCode a r d m) =
      RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionValue a r d m

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionCode_length
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m : ℕ),
  (RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionCode a r d m).length = RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionBound r d m

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionValue.eq_1
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m : ℕ) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionValue a r d m p =
    (↑m)⁻¹ * (RealizationBoundaries.codedNormalValue a r d p - ↑m * RealizationBoundaries.oracleSection a (r / ↑m) p)

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionValue_zero_outside
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
      RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionBound r d m ≤ ↑p → RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionValue a r d m p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionValue_zero_outside._proof_1_1

∀ (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) {m : ℕ} (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  ↑p ≤ r.den * (r / ↑m).den → r.den * (r / ↑m).den + 1 ≤ ↑p → False

type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W))
  (y : RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x) (z : RealizationBoundaries.DivisorCoordinates m),
  ↑↑((RealizationBoundaries.rootFiberEquiv W hm x y).symm z) = ↑↑y + RealizationBoundaries.coordinateExtension m z

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootFiberTranslation
type:
(W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) →
  (m : ℕ) →
    (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)) →
      RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x →
        ↥(RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m) ≃ RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootFiberTranslation._proof_1
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W))
  (y : RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x) (k : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m)), m • (↑y + ↑k) = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootFiberTranslation._proof_2
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W))
  (y z : RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x), ↑z - ↑y ∈ RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootFiberTranslation._proof_3
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W))
  (y : RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x) (k : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m)),
  ↑⟨↑y + ↑k, ⋯⟩ - ↑y ∈ RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootFiberTranslation._proof_4
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W))
  (y : RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x) (k : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m)), ⟨↑⟨↑y + ↑k, ⋯⟩ - ↑y, ⋯⟩ = k

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootFiberTranslation._proof_5
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W))
  (y z : RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x), m • (↑y + ↑⟨↑z - ↑y, ⋯⟩) = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootFiberTranslation._proof_6
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W))
  (y z : RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x), ⟨↑y + ↑⟨↑z - ↑y, ⋯⟩, ⋯⟩ = z

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootFiberTranslation_apply
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W))
  (y : RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x) (k : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m)),
  ↑((RealizationBoundaries.rootFiberTranslation W m x y) k) = ↑y + ↑k

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootFiber_card
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
      Nat.card (RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x) =
        if ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m → ↑x p = 0 then RealizationBoundaries.primeRadical m else 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootFiber_card_of_obstruction
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
      ↑p ∣ m → ↑x p ≠ 0 → Nat.card (RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x) = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootFiber_card_of_root
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)) (y : RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x),
      Nat.card (RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x) = RealizationBoundaries.primeRadical m

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootFiber_card_of_solvable
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
      (∃ y, m • y = x) → Nat.card (RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x) = RealizationBoundaries.primeRadical m

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootFiber_coset_iff
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W))
  (y : RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x) (z : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  m • z = x ↔ z - ↑y ∈ RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootFiber_finite
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → ∀ (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)), Finite (RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x)

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootFiber_isEmpty
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (¬∃ y, m • y = x) → IsEmpty (RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W m x)

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel._proof_1

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootKernelEquiv
type:
(W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) →
  {m : ℕ} → 0 < m → ↥(RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m) ≃+ RealizationBoundaries.DivisorCoordinates m

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootKernelEquiv._proof_1
type: ∀ {m : ℕ} (i : RealizationBoundaries.DivisorPrime m), Fact (Nat.Prime ↑↑i)

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootKernelEquiv._proof_2
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (z : RealizationBoundaries.DivisorCoordinates m),
      RealizationBoundaries.coordinateExtension m z ∈ RealizationBoundaries.preimage W

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootKernelEquiv._proof_3
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (z : RealizationBoundaries.DivisorCoordinates m),
  (RealizationBoundaries.integerMultiplication W m) ⟨RealizationBoundaries.coordinateExtension m z, ⋯⟩ = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootKernelEquiv._proof_4
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m)),
      RealizationBoundaries.coordinateExtension m ((RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m) ↑y) ∈
        RealizationBoundaries.preimage W

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootKernelEquiv._proof_5
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.integerMultiplication W m)
      ⟨RealizationBoundaries.coordinateExtension m ((RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m) ↑y), ⋯⟩ =
    0

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootKernelEquiv._proof_6
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m)),
  ⟨⟨RealizationBoundaries.coordinateExtension m ((RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m) ↑y), ⋯⟩, ⋯⟩ = y

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootKernelEquiv._proof_7
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (z : RealizationBoundaries.DivisorCoordinates m),
  (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m) ↑⟨⟨RealizationBoundaries.coordinateExtension m z, ⋯⟩, ⋯⟩ = z

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootKernelEquiv._proof_8
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ} (x x_1 : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m) ↑(x + x_1) = (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m) ↑(x + x_1)

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootKernelEquiv_apply
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m))
  (p : RealizationBoundaries.DivisorPrime m), (RealizationBoundaries.rootKernelEquiv W hm) y p = ↑↑y ↑p

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootKernelEquiv_symm_apply
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (z : RealizationBoundaries.DivisorCoordinates m),
  ↑↑((RealizationBoundaries.rootKernelEquiv W hm).symm z) = RealizationBoundaries.coordinateExtension m z

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel_card
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → Nat.card ↥(RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m) = RealizationBoundaries.primeRadical m

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel_coordinate_zero
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m))
  (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ¬↑p ∣ m → ↑↑y p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel_finite
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → Finite ↥(RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m)

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootObstructs
type: (RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) → ℚ → List ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Bool

name: RealizationBoundaries.rootObstructs.eq_1
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m n : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.rootObstructs a r d m n =
    if h : Nat.Prime n then decide (n ∣ m ∧ RealizationBoundaries.codedNormalValue a r d ⟨n, h⟩ ≠ 0) else false

name: RealizationBoundaries.root_defect_zero_outside
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
      d.length ≤ ↑p →
        ¬↑p ∣ r.den * (r / ↑m).den →
          RealizationBoundaries.codedNormalValue a r d p - ↑m * RealizationBoundaries.oracleSection a (r / ↑m) p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.searchStageListing
type: (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → List ℕ

name: RealizationBoundaries.searchStageListing.eq_1
type:
∀ (test : ℕ → ℕ) (s : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.searchStageListing test s =
    RealizationBoundaries.cleanListing
      (RealizationBoundaries.residueLoop (RealizationBoundaries.listingSuccessCell test) 0 s)

name: RealizationBoundaries.searchStageListing_computable
type:
∀ {X : ℕ → Bool} {test : ℕ → ℕ},
  RealizationBoundaries.OracleComputable X test →
    RealizationBoundaries.OracleComputable X fun s => Encodable.encode (RealizationBoundaries.searchStageListing test s)

name: RealizationBoundaries.searchStageListing_mem
type:
∀ (test : ℕ → ℕ) (s n : ℕ),
  n ∈ RealizationBoundaries.searchStageListing test s ↔ ∃ k < s, (Nat.unpair k).1 = n ∧ test k = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect
type: Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime → ℚ → ℚ → RealizationBoundaries.Ambient

name: RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect.eq_1
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect S r t =
    RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S t -
      RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + t)

name: RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect_finite
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect S r t ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect_support
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.support (RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect S r t) ⊆
    RealizationBoundaries.exceptional (r.den * t.den)

name: RealizationBoundaries.section_difference_finite
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite →
    ∀ (r : ℚ),
      RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a) r -
          RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector b) r ∈
        RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.seedPackets
type:
{I : Type u} →
  (M : I → Type v) → [inst : (i : I) → AddCommGroup (M i)] → Set ↥(RealizationBoundaries.packetSum M) → Set I

name: RealizationBoundaries.seed_mem_endomorphismHull
type: ∀ {G : Type u} [inst : AddGroup G] {S : Set G} {s : G}, s ∈ S → s ∈ RealizationBoundaries.endomorphismHull S

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorCorrection

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorCorrection.congr_simp
type:
∀ (a a_1 : ℕ → Bool) (e_a : a = a_1) (b b_1 : ℕ → Bool) (e_b : b = b_1) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite) (r r_1 : ℚ),
  r = r_1 → RealizationBoundaries.selectorCorrection a b h r = RealizationBoundaries.selectorCorrection a_1 b_1 ⋯ r_1

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorEquivOfNonzeroDiagonal
type:
(S T : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) →
  S.Infinite →
    (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup T)) →
      (∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
          RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S)
              (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T) f p ≠
            0) →
        ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S) ≃+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup T)

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorEquivOfNonzeroDiagonal._proof_1
type: AddSubmonoidClass (AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) RealizationBoundaries.Ambient

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorEquivOfNonzeroDiagonal._proof_2
type: AddSubmonoidClass (AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) RealizationBoundaries.Ambient

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorEquivOfNonzeroDiagonal._proof_3
type:
∀ (S T : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  S.Infinite →
    ∀ (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup T)),
      (∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
          RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S)
              (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T) f p ≠
            0) →
        RealizationBoundaries.DiagonalAdmissible (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T)
          (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S)
          (RealizationBoundaries.inverseDiagonal
            (RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S)
              (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T) f))

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorEquivOfNonzeroDiagonal._proof_4
type:
∀ (S T : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (hS : S.Infinite)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup T))
  (hn :
    ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
      RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S) (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T) f
          p ≠
        0)
  (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.diagonalRestriction (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T)
        (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S)
        (RealizationBoundaries.inverseDiagonal
          (RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S)
            (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T) f))
        ⋯)
      (f x) =
    x

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorEquivOfNonzeroDiagonal._proof_5
type:
∀ (S T : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (hS : S.Infinite)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup T))
  (hn :
    ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
      RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S) (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T) f
          p ≠
        0)
  (y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup T)),
  f
      ((RealizationBoundaries.diagonalRestriction (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T)
          (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S)
          (RealizationBoundaries.inverseDiagonal
            (RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S)
              (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T) f))
          ⋯)
        y) =
    y

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorEquivOfNonzeroDiagonal._proof_6
type:
∀ (S T : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup T))
  (x y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S)), f (x + y) = f x + f y

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorEquivOfNonzeroDiagonal_apply
type:
∀ (S T : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (hS : S.Infinite)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup T))
  (hn :
    ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
      RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S) (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T) f
          p ≠
        0)
  (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.selectorEquivOfNonzeroDiagonal S T hS f hn) x = f x

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorEquiv_inverse_coordinate
type:
∀ (S T : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (hS : S.Infinite)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup T))
  (hn :
    ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
      RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S) (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T) f
          p ≠
        0)
  (y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup T)) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  ↑((RealizationBoundaries.selectorEquivOfNonzeroDiagonal S T hS f hn).symm y) p =
    (RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S) (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T) f
          p)⁻¹ *
      ↑y p

            (RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S)

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorHomEquiv._proof_2
type:
∀ (S T : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime)
  (c :
    { c //
      ∃ r,
        (RealizationBoundaries.diagonal c) (RealizationBoundaries.indicator S) -
            RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection T r ∈
          RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport }),
  RealizationBoundaries.DiagonalAdmissible (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S) (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T)
    ↑c

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorHomEquiv._proof_3
type:
∀ (S T : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup T)),

    (RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S) (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T) f)

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorHomEquiv._proof_4
type:
∀ (S T : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup T)),
  RealizationBoundaries.diagonalRestriction (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S)
      (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T)
      (RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S) (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T)
        f)

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorHomEquiv._proof_5
type:
∀ (S T : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime)
  (c :
    { c //
      ∃ r,
        (RealizationBoundaries.diagonal c) (RealizationBoundaries.indicator S) -
            RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection T r ∈
          RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport }),
  ∃ r,
    (RealizationBoundaries.diagonal
            (RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S)
              (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T)
              (RealizationBoundaries.diagonalRestriction (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S)
                (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T) ↑c ⋯)))
          (RealizationBoundaries.indicator S) -
        RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection T r ∈
      RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorHomEquiv._proof_6
type:
∀ (S T : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime)
  (c :
    { c //
      ∃ r,

  ⟨RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S) (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T)

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorRational._proof_1
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} (hS : S.Infinite),
  ((RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm.realizationEquiv hS).symm 0).rational = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorRational._proof_2
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} (hS : S.Infinite) (x y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S)),
  ((RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm.realizationEquiv hS).symm (x + y)).rational =
    ((RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm.realizationEquiv hS).symm x).rational +
      ((RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm.realizationEquiv hS).symm y).rational

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorRational_eq_zero_iff
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} (hS : S.Infinite) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.selectorRational hS) x = 0 ↔ ↑x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorTuringDegree_le_iff

name: RealizationBoundaries.selector_completion_reflection
type:
∀ (S T : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  S.Infinite →
    ∀ (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup T)),

name: RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup._proof_1
type:
∀ (B : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) {x y : ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport},
  x ∈ {x | RealizationBoundaries.support ↑x ⊆ B} →
    y ∈ {x | RealizationBoundaries.support ↑x ⊆ B} →
      ∀ ⦃p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime⦄, p ∈ RealizationBoundaries.support ↑(x + y) → p ∈ B

name: RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup._proof_2
type: ∀ (B : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime), {p | ¬↑0 p = 0} ⊆ B

name: RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup._proof_3
type:
∀ (B : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) {x : ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport},
  x ∈ {x | RealizationBoundaries.support ↑x ⊆ B} →
    ∀ ⦃p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime⦄, p ∈ RealizationBoundaries.support ↑(-x) → p ∈ B

name: RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup_complement
type:
∀ (B : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  IsCompl (RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup B) (RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup Bᶜ)

name: RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup_eq_seedClosure
type:
∀ (B : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup B = AddSubgroup.closure (RealizationBoundaries.primeSeed '' B)

name: RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup_hasPrimeTorsion_iff
type:
∀ (B : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  RealizationBoundaries.HasPrimeTorsion (↥(RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup B)) p ↔ p ∈ B

name: RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup_inter
type:
∀ (B C : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup (B ∩ C) =
    RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup B ⊓ RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup C

name: RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup_isomorphic_iff
type:
∀ (B C : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  Nonempty (↥(RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup B) ≃+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup C)) ↔ B = C

name: RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup_subgroupSpectrum
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup (RealizationBoundaries.subgroupSpectrum H) = H

name: RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup_union
type:
∀ (B C : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup (B ∪ C) =
    RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup B ⊔ RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup C

name: RealizationBoundaries.spectrum_determined_by_all_observations
type: ∀ (B C : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime), (∀ (F : Finset RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ∀ p ∈ F, p ∈ B ↔ p ∈ C) → B = C

name: RealizationBoundaries.squarefreeCyclicQuotient
type:
(W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) →
  (F : Type u_1) →
    [inst : AddGroup F] →
      [Finite F] → IsAddCyclic F → Squarefree (Nat.card F) → ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) →+ F

name: RealizationBoundaries.squarefreeCyclicQuotient._proof_1
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (F : Type u_1),
  (RealizationBoundaries.multiples W (Nat.card F)).Normal

name: RealizationBoundaries.squarefreeCyclicQuotient._proof_2
type: ∀ (F : Type u_1), Squarefree (Nat.card F) → RealizationBoundaries.primeRadical (Nat.card F) = Nat.card F

name: RealizationBoundaries.squarefreeCyclicQuotient_surjective
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (F : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup F] [inst_1 : Finite F]
  (hc : IsAddCyclic F) (hs : Squarefree (Nat.card F)),
  Function.Surjective ⇑(RealizationBoundaries.squarefreeCyclicQuotient W F hc hs)

name: RealizationBoundaries.subgroupMembership_binarySpectrum_continuous

name: RealizationBoundaries.subgroupSpectrumOrderIso._proof_1
type:
∀ {B C : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime},
  { toFun := RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup, invFun := RealizationBoundaries.subgroupSpectrum,
          left_inv := RealizationBoundaries.subgroupSpectrum_spectrumSubgroup,
          right_inv := RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup_subgroupSpectrum }
        B ≤
      { toFun := RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup, invFun := RealizationBoundaries.subgroupSpectrum,
          left_inv := RealizationBoundaries.subgroupSpectrum_spectrumSubgroup,
          right_inv := RealizationBoundaries.spectrumSubgroup_subgroupSpectrum }
        C ↔
    B ⊆ C

name: RealizationBoundaries.supportedPackets._proof_1

  {x y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.packetSum M)},
  x ∈ {x | ∀ i ∉ R, ↑x i = 0} → y ∈ {x | ∀ i ∉ R, ↑x i = 0} → ∀ i ∉ R, ↑(x + y) i = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.supportedPackets._proof_2
type: ∀ {I : Type u_1} (M : I → Type u_2) [inst : (i : I) → AddCommGroup (M i)] (R : Set I), ∀ i ∉ R, ↑0 i = ↑0 i

name: RealizationBoundaries.supportedPackets._proof_3
type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (M : I → Type u_2) [inst : (i : I) → AddCommGroup (M i)] (R : Set I)
  {x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.packetSum M)}, x ∈ {x | ∀ i ∉ R, ↑x i = 0} → ∀ i ∉ R, ↑(-x) i = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.topological_generator_transport
RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor
type:
(a b : ℕ → Bool) →
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    (↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)) →
      ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor._proof_1
type: AddSubmonoidClass (AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) RealizationBoundaries.Ambient

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor._proof_2
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    ∀ (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)),
      ↑(f 0) ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor._proof_3
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)), ⟨↑(f 0), ⋯⟩ = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor._proof_4
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    ∀ (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b))
      (x y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)), ↑(f (x + y)) ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor._proof_5
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b))
  (x y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)), ⟨↑(f (x + y)), ⋯⟩ = ⟨↑(f x), ⋯⟩ + ⟨↑(f y), ⋯⟩

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor_commutes
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport.subtype.comp (RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor a b h f) =
    (RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b).subtype.comp f

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor_unique
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b))
  (g : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport.subtype.comp g = (RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b).subtype.comp f →
    g = RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor a b h f

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor_val
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b))
  (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)), ↑((RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor a b h f) x) = ↑(f x)

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsion_iff_finiteSupport
type: ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), (∃ m, 0 < m ∧ m • x = 0) ↔ x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.tracedCertifiedRootSolver
type: (RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) → ℚ → List ℕ → ℕ → Except ℕ (ℚ × List ℕ) × List RealizationBoundaries.Prime

name: RealizationBoundaries.tracedCertifiedRootSolver.eq_1
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.tracedCertifiedRootSolver a r d m =
    match (RealizationBoundaries.tracedFirstRootObstruction a r d m).1 with
    | some p => (Except.error p, (RealizationBoundaries.tracedFirstRootObstruction a r d m).2)
    | none =>
      have correction := RealizationBoundaries.tracedRootCorrectionCode a r d m;
      (Except.ok (r / ↑m, correction.1), (RealizationBoundaries.tracedFirstRootObstruction a r d m).2 ++ correction.2)

name: RealizationBoundaries.tracedCertifiedRootSolver.match_1
type: (motive : Option ℕ → Sort u_1) → (x : Option ℕ) → ((p : ℕ) → motive (some p)) → (Unit → motive none) → motive x

name: RealizationBoundaries.tracedCertifiedRootSolver_erase
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m : ℕ),
  (RealizationBoundaries.tracedCertifiedRootSolver a r d m).1 = RealizationBoundaries.certifiedRootSolver a r d m

name: RealizationBoundaries.tracedCertifiedRootSolver_query_bound
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m : ℕ),
  (RealizationBoundaries.tracedCertifiedRootSolver a r d m).2.length ≤
    m + 1 + 2 * RealizationBoundaries.rootCorrectionBound r d m

name: RealizationBoundaries.tracedCertifiedRootSolver_sound
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (t : ℚ) (e : List ℕ),
      (RealizationBoundaries.tracedCertifiedRootSolver a r d m).1 = Except.ok (t, e) →
        m • RealizationBoundaries.codedNormalValue a t e = RealizationBoundaries.codedNormalValue a r d

name: RealizationBoundaries.tracedFirstRootObstruction
type: (RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) → ℚ → List ℕ → ℕ → Option ℕ × List RealizationBoundaries.Prime

name: RealizationBoundaries.tracedFirstRootObstruction.eq_1
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.tracedFirstRootObstruction a r d m =
    RealizationBoundaries.findRootTrace (RealizationBoundaries.tracedRootObstructs a r d m) (List.range (m + 1))

name: RealizationBoundaries.tracedFirstRootObstruction_erase
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m : ℕ),
  (RealizationBoundaries.tracedFirstRootObstruction a r d m).1 = RealizationBoundaries.firstRootObstruction a r d m

name: RealizationBoundaries.tracedFirstRootObstruction_query_bound
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (d : List ℕ) (m : ℕ),
  (RealizationBoundaries.tracedFirstRootObstruction a r d m).2.length ≤ m + 1

name: RealizationBoundaries.tracedOracleSection
type:
(RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) →
  ℚ → (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime) → RealizationBoundaries.Coordinate p × List RealizationBoundaries.Prime

name: RealizationBoundaries.tracedOracleSection.eq_1
type:
∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  RealizationBoundaries.tracedOracleSection a r p =
    (if (RealizationBoundaries.tracedSelectorRead a p).1 = true then ↑r else 0,

name: RealizationBoundaries.tracedOracleSection_erase

∀ (a : RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Bool) (r : ℚ) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),

name: RealizationBoundaries.tracedOracleSection_trace

name: RealizationBoundaries.tracedRootCorrectionCode

name: RealizationBoundaries.tracedRootCorrectionCode.eq_1

name: RealizationBoundaries.tracedRootCorrectionCode_query_bound

name: RealizationBoundaries.unreachable_packet_obstructs
type:
∀ {I : Type u} (M : I → Type v) [inst : (i : I) → AddCommGroup (M i)] (E : I → I → Prop)
  (O : Set (AddMonoid.End ↥(RealizationBoundaries.packetSum M))) (S : Set ↥(RealizationBoundaries.packetSum M)),
  (∀ T ∈ O, ∀ (i j : I), ¬E i j → ∀ (a : M i), RealizationBoundaries.packetTransfer M T i j a = 0) →
    ∀ (j : I),
      ¬RealizationBoundaries.GraphReach E (RealizationBoundaries.seedPackets M S) j →
        ∀ [Nontrivial (M j)],
          (∀ x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.primitiveOperatorHull O S, ↑x j = 0) ∧
            RealizationBoundaries.primitiveOperatorHull O S ≠ ⊤

name: RealizationBoundaries.unreachable_packet_obstructs_topological
type:
∀ {I : Type u} (M : I → Type v) [inst : (i : I) → AddCommGroup (M i)] (E : I → I → Prop)
  (O : Set (AddMonoid.End ↥(RealizationBoundaries.packetSum M))) (S : Set ↥(RealizationBoundaries.packetSum M)),
  (∀ T ∈ O, ∀ (i j : I), ¬E i j → ∀ (a : M i), RealizationBoundaries.packetTransfer M T i j a = 0) →
    ∀ (j : I),
      ¬RealizationBoundaries.GraphReach E (RealizationBoundaries.seedPackets M S) j →
        ∀ [Nontrivial (M j)] [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace ↥(RealizationBoundaries.packetSum M)]
          [inst_3 : IsTopologicalAddGroup ↥(RealizationBoundaries.packetSum M)] [inst_4 : TopologicalSpace (M j)]
          [T2Space (M j)],
          Continuous ⇑(RealizationBoundaries.packetProjection M j) →
            (∀ x ∈ (RealizationBoundaries.primitiveOperatorHull O S).topologicalClosure, ↑x j = 0) ∧
              (RealizationBoundaries.primitiveOperatorHull O S).topologicalClosure ≠ ⊤
